# Power calculation for two-sample pooled t-test
# Comparing two independent normal means with equal variances

# Study parameters
n_per_group <- 32
mean_diff <- 4.3  # expected difference (dBA)
common_sd <- 7.8  # common standard deviation (dBA)
alpha <- 0.05
sidedness <- "one-sided"

# Calculate standard error
# SE = sqrt(SD^2 * (1/n1 + 1/n2)) = SD * sqrt(2/n) for equal-sized groups
se <- common_sd * sqrt(2 / n_per_group)

# Calculate noncentrality parameter
# λ = mean_diff / SE
noncentrality <- mean_diff / se

# Degrees of freedom
df <- n_per_group + n_per_group - 2

# For one-sided test at alpha 0.05, find critical t-value
# H0: μ1 - μ2 = 0 vs H1: μ1 - μ2 > 0 (one-sided, upper tail)
critical_t <- qt(1 - alpha, df)

# Power = P(t > critical_t | H1 is true)
# = 1 - P(t ≤ critical_t | λ)
# Using non-central t-distribution
power <- 1 - pt(critical_t, df = df, ncp = noncentrality)

# Summary of calculations
cat("Two-Sample Pooled t-Test: Power Calculation\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
cat("Study Design:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Sample size per group: %d participants\n", n_per_group))
cat(sprintf("  Total sample size: %d participants\n", 2 * n_per_group))
cat(sprintf("  Expected mean difference: %.1f dBA\n", mean_diff))
cat(sprintf("  Common standard deviation: %.1f dBA\n", common_sd))
cat(sprintf("  Significance level (α): %.4f\n", alpha))
cat(sprintf("  Test: One-sided (H1: μ1 > μ2)\n\n"))

cat("Statistical Calculations:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Standard error (SE): %.6f dBA\n", se))
cat(sprintf("  Noncentrality parameter (λ): %.6f\n", noncentrality))
cat(sprintf("  Degrees of freedom: %d\n", df))
cat(sprintf("  Critical t-value: %.6f\n", critical_t))
cat(sprintf("  Power: %.6f\n", power))

# Output for structured reporting
results <- data.frame(
  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("\n\nStructured Result:\n")
print(results)

# Emit the result for POWER_AGENT_RESULT

  list(results = results),
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  digits = 15
)

# Power calculation for two-sample pooled t-test
# Comparing two independent normal means with equal variances

# Study parameters
n_per_group <- 32
mean_diff <- 4.3  # expected difference (dBA)
common_sd <- 7.8  # common standard deviation (dBA)
alpha <- 0.05
sidedness <- "one-sided"

# Calculate standard error
# SE = sqrt(SD^2 * (1/n1 + 1/n2)) = SD * sqrt(2/n) for equal-sized groups
se <- common_sd * sqrt(2 / n_per_group)

# Calculate noncentrality parameter
# λ = mean_diff / SE
noncentrality <- mean_diff / se

# Degrees of freedom
df <- n_per_group + n_per_group - 2

# For one-sided test at alpha 0.05, find critical t-value
# H0: μ1 - μ2 = 0 vs H1: μ1 - μ2 > 0 (one-sided, upper tail)
critical_t <- qt(1 - alpha, df)

# Power = P(t > critical_t | H1 is true)
# = 1 - P(t ≤ critical_t | λ)
# Using non-central t-distribution
power <- 1 - pt(critical_t, df = df, ncp = noncentrality)

# Summary of calculations
cat("Two-Sample Pooled t-Test: Power Calculation\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
cat("Study Design:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Sample size per group: %d participants\n", n_per_group))
cat(sprintf("  Total sample size: %d participants\n", 2 * n_per_group))

cat(sprintf("  Common standard deviation: %.1f dBA\n", common_sd))

cat(sprintf("  Test: One-sided (H1: μ1 > μ2)\n\n"))

cat("Statistical Calculations:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Standard error (SE): %.6f dBA\n", se))
cat(sprintf("  Noncentrality parameter (λ): %.6f\n", noncentrality))
cat(sprintf("  Degrees of freedom: %d\n", df))
cat(sprintf("  Critical t-value: %.6f\n", critical_t))
cat(sprintf("  Power: %.6f\n", power))

# Output for structured reporting
results <- data.frame(
  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("\n\nStructured Result:\n")
print(results)

# Emit the result for POWER_AGENT_RESULT

  list(results = results),
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  digits = 15
)
